name: Hand-Embroidered Unstitched Kurta — Rose Pink
description: Rose-pink kurta fabric covered in dense multicolour hand-embroidery — roses, violets and leafy vines worked in resham thread from the neckline to the hem. Sold unstitched so your tailor can cut it exactly to your fit.

name: Hand-Embroidered Unstitched Kurta — Sage
description: Sage-toned kurta fabric with coral and ivory florals worked in climbing vines, finished with a beaded coral trim line down the front. Sold unstitched and ready for your tailor.

name: Embroidered Unstitched Kurta — Wisteria
description: Crisp off-white kurta fabric scattered with wisteria-purple floral sprays and fine vinework — light, airy handwork for everyday elegance. Sold unstitched, ready for your tailor.

name: Chikankari Mirror-Work Kurta — Mustard
description: A ready-to-wear mustard kurta with white chikankari-style embroidery and delicate mirror accents around the neckline and front panel. Bright, festive and easy to style with white or contrast trousers.

name: Embroidered Kurta — Pink & Teal
description: A soft pink kurta embroidered with teal and turquoise florals — denser at the yoke, scattering down the front. Cool-toned handwork on a warm base that works for daytime and casual wear alike.

name: Heavy Embroidered Kurta — Navy
description: A deep navy kurta with dense white, pink and green floral embroidery framing the neckline panel and scattering down the front. Rich evening handwork on a midnight base.

name: Heavy Embroidered Kurta — Emerald
description: An emerald-green kurta carrying some of our heaviest handwork — yellow and powder-blue florals embroidered edge to edge, sleeves included. A statement piece for daawats and dinners.

name: Heavy Embroidered Kurta — Pink Blossom
description: A cream kurta embroidered all over with pink blossoms and green vinework in thick, hand-laid thread — heavy, joyful handwork in our signature palette.

name: Hand-Embroidered Chaddar — Blush Pink
description: A blush-pink chaddar with tone-on-tone rose embroidery and subtle shimmer accents worked across the full drape. Soft, romantic handwork that turns a simple outfit into an occasion.
